files.rules/candidate_researcher_at_iis.pl:
:- module(candidate_researcher_at_iis, [researcher_at_iis/2]).
:- use_module('../data/epoch_data.pl').

researcher_at_iis(Person, EvidenceFactIds) :-
    epoch_data:fact(ParticipantFact, Participation, 'http://fogid.net/o/participant', iri(Person)),
    epoch_data:fact(OrganizationFact, Participation, 'http://fogid.net/o/in-org', iri('urn:logiclens:org:iis')),
    epoch_data:fact(RoleFact, Participation, 'http://fogid.net/o/role', literal("исследователь", lang('ru'))),
    sort([ParticipantFact, OrganizationFact, RoleFact], EvidenceFactIds).
